subject.title: [Feature]: Silent preflight transcription in requireMention channels

question: Should OpenClaw add an opt-in silent STT history-enrichment mode for unmentioned Discord audio in requireMention channels, and should that mode be Discord-specific or a shared channel contract?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested behavior adds a new config surface and changes privacy, cost, and retained-context expectations for audio that did not directly invoke the bot.

options.title: Shared opt-in history enrichment
options.body: Define a generic channel-history enrichment contract and implement Discord first with explicit provenance, failure, retention, and no-reply tests.

options.title: Discord-only preflightTranscribe
options.body: Add the requested guild/channel option inside the Discord plugin first, accepting possible later migration if Signal or other channels need the same mode.

options.title: Decline silent retention
options.body: Keep transcription tied to direct or mentioned turns and document that unmentioned requireMention audio remains placeholder history.

recommendation.title: Shared opt-in history enrichment
recommendation.body: Define a generic channel-history enrichment contract and implement Discord first with explicit provenance, failure, retention, and no-reply tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the original requireMention audio preflight behavior that this request extends.
